_comment: Mattel Creations Hot Wheels monitor. Edit this file to change what gets watched.

filters._comment: collector = only RLC / Elite 64 style items. Set mode to 'all' to watch every Hot Wheels listing.

stock_probe._comment: OFF by default on purpose. Mattel's robots.txt disallows /cart/ and /cart.js to automated clients, so turning this on risks their bot protection blocking the GitHub Actions runner and killing the monitor silently. Flip 'enabled' to true at your own discretion.

http.user_agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Linux; Android 14) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/126.0 Mobile Safari/537.36
